high.title: Is Indonesia Really Heading Towards 1998-Style Crisis?
high.summary: Economists debate whether Indonesia is heading towards a 1998-style crisis amid recent rupiah weakness and market volatility. However, experts argue current economic structure is much stronger than during the Asian crisis.

high.title: 'Sell Indonesia' Phenomenon After Rupiah and IHSG Weakness - Purbaya Responds
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya addresses international media reports of 'sell Indonesia' phenomenon amid massive pressure on rupiah and IHSG decline. He disputes claims that international writers don't fully understand Indonesia's economic condition.

high.title: Purbaya Reveals Root Cause of Continuous IHSG Decline - Negative Economic Perception
high.summary: IHSG has fallen 35.30% to 5,594.76 throughout 2026 from its peak above 9,100. Finance Minister attributes the decline to negative sentiment despite strong economic fundamentals and growth.

high.title: BI Governor Meets Dasco and Purbaya at Parliament - Agrees on 2 Strategies to Protect Rupiah
high.summary: BI Governor Perry Warjiyo confirms close coordination between monetary and fiscal authorities to strengthen rupiah exchange rate. The meeting focused on synchronized fiscal-monetary policies to stabilize the currency.

high.title: Purbaya: We Are Not Heading Towards 1998 Situation - Only Negative Sentiment
high.summary: Finance Minister firmly states Indonesia's economy is not heading towards 1997-1998 crisis conditions. He emphasizes that fiscal and economic fundamentals remain strong, with current rupiah pressure driven by market sentiment.

high.title: Purbaya Prohibits US Dollar Transactions at Ports - 'Rupiah Weakness Makes My Job Difficult'
high.summary: Finance Minister requests port businesses to report any services requiring US dollar payments, emphasizing all transactions in Indonesia should use rupiah. This move aims to support rupiah stability amid current weakness.

high.title: Djarum Group Company IBST Plans Delisting - Voluntary Tender at Rp 5,400 per Share
high.summary: PT Inti Bangun Sejahtera Tbk (IBST), part of Djarum Group, announces delisting plan from Indonesian Stock Exchange with voluntary tender offer at Rp 5,400 per share from July 1-30, 2026.

high.title: Prabowo Signs Single Gateway Export Regulation Through State-Owned Enterprises
high.summary: President Prabowo officially signs Government Regulation No. 24/2026 on strategic natural resource commodity export governance through state-owned enterprises. The policy initially covers coal, palm oil, and ferro alloy exports.

high.title: Gold Prices Plunge This Deep in One Week
high.summary: Gold prices showed declining trend in first week of June 2026, falling from Rp 2.799.000 per gram on Monday June 1 to Rp 2.738.000 per gram on Saturday June 6, representing significant weekly decline.

medium.title: SBY's Strategy to Help Indonesia Survive 2008 Economic Crisis
medium.summary: Former President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono shares his experience managing the 2008 global financial crisis, emphasizing market confidence, fiscal prudence, and policy coordination as key survival strategies.

medium.title: Bank Mandiri Taspen Fires Employee Suspected of Investment Fraud
medium.summary: PT Bank Mandiri Taspen dismisses employee involved in investment fraud at Purwokerto branch, Central Java. The company emphasizes zero tolerance for actions violating integrity and good corporate governance.

medium.title: KoinWorks CEO Detained by Attorney General - Shareholders Called by OJK
medium.summary: Financial Services Authority (OJK) responds to corruption case involving PT Lunaria Annua Teknologi (KoinWorks) by calling shareholders for questioning after three executives were detained by Attorney General.

medium.title: Root Cause of 3,100 Containers Piling Up at Tanjung Priok Port
medium.summary: Finance Minister investigates reports of 3,100 containers stuck at Tanjung Priok Port related to 3,000 documents. Businesses complain about supply chain disruptions and increased dwelling time affecting industrial raw materials.

medium.title: Purbaya Responds - Free Nutritious Meals and Village Cooperatives Considered APBN Burden
medium.summary: Finance Minister refutes claims that Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) and Village Cooperatives programs burden state budget, emphasizing flexible program design with room for efficiency as demonstrated by President Prabowo.

medium.title: Indonesia Has Opportunity to Avoid US Import Tariffs
medium.summary: Indonesia has strong chance to get US tariff relief as US Trade Representative opens options to grant 18 product exclusion requests under Section 301 investigation, potentially reducing export costs and improving competitiveness.

medium.title: Indonesia to Face New 10% Tariff from US - Government Responds
medium.summary: US proposes new 10-12.5% tariffs on imports from 60 countries including Indonesia related to forced labor investigation under Section 301. Indonesian government says it will carefully review USTR announcement.

medium.title: Food Prices: Cooking Oil and Shallots Rise, Chili Still Rp 75,000/kg
medium.summary: Most food prices show decline, but shallots, garlic and cooking oil prices increase. Shallots rise 6.99% to Rp 54,350/kg while chili remains at high Rp 75,000/kg according to BI food price data.

medium.title: Ferry Crossing Fare Discounts During School Holidays - Mark the Dates
medium.summary: PT ASDP Indonesia Ferry offers transportation discounts for ferry services during school holidays with 100% port service fee discount, equivalent to 21.9% of total crossing ticket fare from June 20 - July 5, 2026.

medium.title: US Secretly Targets Iranian Assets to Finance War Damage Costs
medium.summary: US government plans to transfer Iranian assets to Gulf states for reconstruction and damage repair caused by Iran, following recent drone attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent ordered team to calculate total damage costs.
